thread:
vivian: Noticing an uptick in client-handshake failures after SDK 2.8.0 + runtime 4.1.0 rolled into ap-south. Small customer impact but increasing. Suggest a targeted soft-pin to runtime v4.0.3 for ap-south while SDK team verifies negotiation fallback.
raj: Can you share short repro and error sample? Do we know if it's kv-cache related or protocol mismatch?
henry: telemetry link: https://telemetry.redwood/ops/ap-south/handshake -> handshake_fail_rate: 2.4% ap-south, baseline elsewhere <0.2%. Repro on internal canary: sdk-test --model llama-mini-quant --seq 900 --sdk 2.8.0. Error: "negotiation: unsupported_feature_code 0x8" at ~350 tokens.
vivian: Repro command and abbreviated log attached. We rolled back nodes to runtime 4.0.3 and failures dropped to ~0.05%.
marie: If we scope a soft-pin at routing layer to 4.0.3 for ap-south it limits impact. Confirm Dedicated racks unaffected?
raj: Dedicated unaffected. This is hosted routing only.
deploybot: pin_request RQ-5502 created (creator=vivian). scope=region:ap-south, runtime=4.0.3, type=soft, expire=2026-04-03T08:00:00Z, reason="client negotiate fallback regression with SDK 2.8.0 + runtime 4.1.0 in ap-south". Pending approvals: release-leads + oncall.
ops-bot: Runbook: https://runbook.redwood/pinning -> soft-pin steps, warm KV cache guidance, rollback: deployctl unpin + flush-routing-cache + notify SDK.
henry: Proposed canary: route 15% traffic to 4.0.3 for 30m, synthetic longseq probes every 2m. Success criteria: handshake_fail_rate <0.2% and no p99 latency spikes.
marie: Add a watch for client-side retries — some retries mask failures. Need to check logs for duplicate request IDs.
raj: SDK fix PR is draft: https://git.redwood/sdk/pull/4955 - negotiation fallback and better feature-negotiation logging. Tests passing locally, CI slightly flaky on legacy-negotiation test.
vivian: plan: request approvals, apply soft-pin in next 10m window, run canary, if stable expand to 100% ap-south. If fail rate >0.5% within 30m -> rollback unpin to 4.1.0 and escalate.
ops-bot: Checklist: [x] pin request RQ-5502 created, [ ] approvals, [ ] pin applied, [ ] canary monitoring, [ ] rollback criteria recorded.
marie: release note stub: https://git.redwood/release-notes/3405 - "ap-south: temporary routing to runtime v4.0.3 due to SDK negotiation regression affecting long sequences; SDK PR 4955 under review."
raj: approve
henry: approve
deploybot: Approvals recorded. Applying RQ-5502 to ap-south now.
vivian: Canary active, 15% traffic to 4.0.3. Dashboards: https://telemetry.redwood/ap-south/overview.
marie: early numbers at 6m: handshake_fail_rate -> 0.07% after pin. p99 stable. Good sign.
raj: I'll keep an eye on customer support queue for any new incidents. If we extend pin beyond 36h, we'll coordinate comms.
henry: Reminder for postmortem: capture failing test name (legacy-negotiation-900) and SDK PR link.
vivian: thanks all — will update when we either unpin or extend.
